title: Cartridge Saves Battery Myth

scenes.text: Nintendo's 1985 cartridge held a secret battery for game saves
Everyone believes every classic game cartridge needed a battery to keep saves
scenes.label: All cartridges used batteries

scenes.text: In reality only early NES titles used battery‑backed RAM; later games switched to EEPROM flash memory
scenes.label: Only early NES used batteries

scenes.text: Battery or EEPROM? The shift happened in the early 1990s
scenes.label: Battery or EEPROM
scenes.sub: Later games switched to flash memory

scenes.text: Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.

description: Many think every retro cartridge needed a battery to save progress. We reveal which ones really did and why the technology changed. Stay tuned for more myth‑busting!
